overview: Tinhlangano tikhicita lwati lolukhulu kakhulu ngekusebentisa tinhlelo tekusebenta, kuthengiselana, emakhasimende, kusebenta, emadivayisi, kanye nemaplatifomu edijithali. Insayeya akuseyiyo nje kuhlanganisa idatha; kuvisisa leyo mininingwane kanye nekuyigucula ibe buhlakani lobusebentako.

overview: Baholi bemabhizinisi kanye nemacembu lasebentako bacindzeteleke elwatini lolunembile kute bente tincumo letiphumelelako. Tinhlelo Tetfu Telwatiso Nekubika tisita tinhlangano kutsi tibutsele ndzawonye, ​​tihlele, tihlatiye, futsi tetfule lwati lwebhizinisi ngetinhlelo telwatiso letihlelekile, emapulatifomu ekubika, emadeshibhodi, kanye nekusebenta kwekubika lokuzenzakalelayo.

Tinhlangano tivame kuba nelwati lolusakatwe kuto tonkhe tinhlelo tekusebenta, emaspredishithi, ema-database, kanye netinhlelo tekusebenta. Loku kwenta kube matima kusungula umbono lohambisanako wekusebenta kwebhizinisi. Sisita ekuhlanganiseni imithombo yelwatiso ibe tindzawo tekubika letihlelekile letiniketa lwati lwebhizinisi lolwetsembekile, lolufinyelelekako, nalolungagucuki.

Siklama tindzawo tekubika letitungelete indlela inhlangano yakho lesebenta ngayo, siletsa tindlela tekuphila letihlelekile kusuka kudatha kuya esincumeni letentelwe onkhe emazinga ekuphatsa.

overview: Tindzawo te-IT tesimanje tiyinkimbinkimbi futsi tiyashintja njalo. Tinhlangano tidzinga sakhiwonchanti lesetsembekile, tinhlelo tekusebenta, emanethiwekhi, kuphepha, kugadza, kanye nekwesekelwa kwetebucwepheshe kute kugcinwe kusebenta kwemabhizinisi.

customDevelopment.pillar7Desc: Kugadza lokusebentako 24/7, i-telemetry yetemphilo, kuhlolwa kwekusebenta, kufaka emabala ekuphepha, kanye nekunakekelwa lokuchubekako kwe-SLA.
customDevelopment.pillar8Desc: Kushesha kwesici njalo, kuhlanganiswa kwekuhlatiya idatha, kutfutfukiswa kwe-AI, kanye nekwakha kwesimanje.

processAutomation.description: Kusebenta ngekuzenzakalela kwekucala kuya ekugcineni kwekusebenta kwemabhizinisi, kuhlanganisa kusebenta ngekuzenzakalela kwenchubo yemarobhothi (RPA), kucubungula imibhalo ngekuhlakanipha, tinjini temitsetfo yebhizinisi, kanye nekuhlanganiswa kweluhlelo.
processAutomation.row1P1: Kucedza kufaka idatha ngesandla lokuphindzaphindziwe, kubuyisana kwetinhlelo letiphambukile, kanye nekuhamba kwemibhalo. Sihambisa emabhothi e-RPA ebhizinisi lenta imisebenti lehlelekile 24/7 ngesilinganiso seliphutsa le-zero.
processAutomation.row1P2: Ngekuhlanganisa tindlela tekusebentisana te-desktop letindzala, ema-backends e-SAP/ERP, kanye nema-database emafu, emabhothi e-software akhulula licembu lakho kutsi ligcilele etinyatselweni temabhizinisi letinemasu.
processAutomation.row2P1: Kutsatsa ngekuzenzakalela, kuhlukanisa, kanye nekukhipha idatha kuma-inivoyisi, tinkontileka, emaphepha emazisi, kanye netimangalo. Emaphayiphi etfu lacondziswa yi-AI acinisekisa emasimu ngekumelene nema-database langekhatsi futsi avusa kuhamba kwemisebenti yekuvuma lokuzenzakalelayo.
processAutomation.row2P2: Finyelela emazinga ekucubungula lacondzile langetulu kwa-95% ngesikhatsi unciphisa kakhulu tikhatsi tekujika kusuka emalangeni kuya emizuzwaneni.
processAutomation.row3Title: Kuvumelanisa Kwemapulatifomu Laphambukile Kusukela Ekupheleni Kuya Ekugcineni
processAutomation.row3P1: Xhuma i-CRM, i-ERP, i-HRMS, kanye nema-API ebhange kube kugeleta kwemininingwane yesikhatsi sangempela lokuhlangene. Sisebentisa tisusa leticondziswa ngumcimbi, imigca yemilayeto, kanye netiphatsi tekubuya emuva letizenzakalelayo.
processAutomation.row3P2: Lwati lugeleta ngaphandle kwemthungo kuwo onkhe ematiko ngaphandle kwekungenelela kwebantfu, lokucedza ema-silos ekusebenta kanye nekubambeleleka kwekuchumana.
processAutomation.row4Title: Kuhlatiya Inchubo Yesikhatsi Sangempela & Kucondza Kwe-Kaizen
processAutomation.row4P1: Landzela tikhatsi tekusebenta kwenchubo, emabalave ekushisa lacindzetelako, imvamisa yemaphutsa, kanye ne-ROI yetimali kumadeshibhodi laphetse ngesikhatsi sangempela.
processAutomation.row4P2: Kuhlolwa lokuchubekako kwekufundza ngemshini kutfola ematfuba lamasha ekusebenta ngekuzenzakalela, kugcina libhizinisi lakho lisebenta ngendlela lefanele.
processAutomation.pillarsSub: Tintfo tekwakha letifakazelwe tekusebenta kwemabhizinisi lahlakaniphile.
processAutomation.pillar1Desc: Kusebenta kwebantfu lokunetinyatselo letinyenti kanye nekwedijithali lokuhlelwe ngendlela letentekelako kanye nekukhuphuka.
processAutomation.pillar2Desc: Emabhothi e-software lasekelwe emtsetfweni lenta imisebenti yekufaka idatha levamile, kubuyisana, kanye nekusebentisa lokuphambukile.
processAutomation.pillar3Desc: Ema-ejenti e-AI lanengcondvo lahumusha umongo, afingqa umbhalo longakahleleki, futsi ente tincumo letizenzakalelayo.
processAutomation.pillar4Desc: Inchubo yekukhicita emayini, kutfola tihibe, kanye nekusebenta kwe-Kaizen lokuchubeka kunciphisa tindleko tekusebenta.
processAutomation.ctaSub: Xhumana nebakhi betfu be-automation kute ubone ematfuba lasetulu e-ROI futsi usebentise imisebenti lehlakaniphile yedijithali.

centreOfExcellence.description: Inhlangano lehlanganisiwe yebakhi labakhulu kanye netingcweti temkhakha letitinikele ekulinganiseni imikhuba yebunjiniyela, kushayela tintfo letinsha, kanye nekusheshisa tinyatselo tedijithali.
centreOfExcellence.row1P1: Sikhungo Setfu Sekusebenta Kahle sisungula emaphethini ekuklama lasemgangatfweni, kuhlolwa lokucinile lokutentakalelako, kanye netindlela tekubuyeketa ikhodi lete sici letisheshisa sikhatsi sekuya emakethe ngesikhatsi sigcina sikweleti sebuchwepheshe sibe ngu-zero.
centreOfExcellence.row1F1: Emaphayiphi lakhipha i-CI/CD letentekelako ngekuhlatiya kwemamethrikhi e-DORA
centreOfExcellence.row1F2: Emabhodi lacinile ekubuyeketa takhiwo & kubusa kwetinsita letincane
centreOfExcellence.row1F3: Kuchubeka nekuphepha kanye nekulungisa butsakatsaka lobuzenzakalelayo
centreOfExcellence.row2P1: Silinga ngetindlela tekufundza ngemshini letisezingeni lelisetulu, ema-ejenti e-AI lakhetsiwe, kanye nekusebenta lokuhlakaniphile kwekusebenta kute sakhe imikhicito yemabhizinisi yesitukulwane lesilandzelako.
centreOfExcellence.row2F1: Kuhlanganiswa kwelwati lwe-AI & RAG lolukhicitako lwemabhizinisi
centreOfExcellence.row2F2: Kusebenta kwe-ejenti ye-AI letimele yenchubo yebhizinisi letentekelako
centreOfExcellence.row2F3: Kusebenta kahle kwemodeli yekufundza ngemshini ngekwemkhuba & kulungisa kahle
centreOfExcellence.row3P1: Siklama futsi silawule tindzawo leticinile letinemafu lamanyenti letakhiwe ngetinhlaka tekuphepha te-zero-trust, sicinisekisa kutsi idatha yakho ihlala ivikelekile etinsongo te-inthanethi temhlaba wonkhe letigucukako.
centreOfExcellence.row3F1: AWS, Azure, & GCP kuhlanganiswa kwesakhiwonchanti semafu lamanyenti
centreOfExcellence.row3F2: Kufinyelela kunethiwekhi lengatsembeki (ZTNA) & tinchubomgomo te-IAM letisekelwe endzimeni
centreOfExcellence.row3F3: Kuskena lokuzenzakalelayo kwekuphepha kwesitja & kulawulwa kwemfihlo
centreOfExcellence.pillarsSub: Tincwadzi tekudlala tekutfutfukisa letihlelekile letinika emandla emapulatifomu labalulekile emsebentini wekushumayela.
centreOfExcellence.pillar1Desc: Kugadza lokuphelele lokucinisekisa kutsi tonkhe tisombululo temabhizinisi tihambisana nekulinganisa lokucinile, kuphepha, kanye nemigomo yekulandzela.
centreOfExcellence.pillar2Desc: Tinhlelo tekuklama tebunikati, emakhithi ekucala e-API, kanye netifanekiso te-microservice ye-backend letinciphisa sikhatsi sekucala sekutfutfukisa nga-40%.
centreOfExcellence.pillar3Desc: Emaphayiphi lahamba embili ekubuka ngesikhatsi sangempela lagadza kuphuta kwesicelo, kuvimbela kukhicita, kanye nekusetjentiswa kwetinsita temafu.
centreOfExcellence.pillar4Desc: Ema-guild langekhatsi lahlelekile kanye netitifiketi letihlakulela emakhono lajulile ebuchwepheshe kulo lonkhe lifu, i-DevOps, kanye ne-AI lesetjentisiwe.
centreOfExcellence.ctaSub: Kusebentisana neSikhungo Sekusebenta Kahle se-Oklut Tech kute kwakhiwe takhiwo temafu leticinile, kwenta umsebenti usebente ngekuzenzakalela, futsi usheshise kuletfwa kwemikhicito yedijithali.
centreOfExcellence.p1Desc: Kusungula kubusa kwekwakha kwemabhizinisi onkhe, tindlela tekuvikela inchubomgomo, kanye nemazinga ekulandzela.
centreOfExcellence.p2Desc: Chaza takhiwo tesimanje tekubhekisa, ticumbi tebuchwepheshe letihloliwe, kanye nemaphethini etinsita letincane.
centreOfExcellence.p3Desc: Sheshisa sivinini sekutfutfukisa ngetincenye letabelwana ngato, tifanekiso, emakhithi ekucala, kanye netinhlelo tekuklama.
centreOfExcellence.p4Desc: Kuceceshwa lokuhlelekile, kwelulekwa ngebuchwepheshe, kanye nekuniketa emakhono emandla ekuphakamisa buciko bebunjiniyela belicembu.
centreOfExcellence.p5Desc: R&D kuma-ejenti e-AI, emaphayiphi latentekelako, kanye netinhlaka tesitukulwane lesilandzelako kute kugcinwe umkhawulo wemakethe.
centreOfExcellence.p6Desc: Emamethrikhi ebunjiniyela lacondziswa yidatha (DORA), kulinganisa kwe-SLA, kanye nekusebenta kahle kwelizinga lokuchubekako.

solutionEngineering.description: Kutfutfukiswa kanye nekutfutfukiswa kwetinhlelo tekusebenta, emapulatifomu, kuhamba kwemisebenti, kanye netisombululo temabhizinisi kute kulungiswe tidzingo temabhizinisi letihlukile kanye nekuletsa kusebenta lokwentelwe wena.
solutionEngineering.row1P1: Isofthiwe lejwayelekile yemabhizinisi ivame kushoda ekuhlangabetaneni netidzingo tebhizinisi letikhetsekile. Licembu letfu lebunjiniyela lakhetsiwe litfutfukisa emamojuli esicelo lakhetsiwe, imitsetfo yebhizinisi lekhetsekile, kanye nekwengeteka lokukhetsekile lokwentelwe imisebenti yakho.
solutionEngineering.row1P2: Kusuka ekutfutfukisweni kwe-CRM kanye ne-ERP ngekwemkhuba kuya kuma-portal lakhetsekile ekusebenta, sakha timphawu letihambisana ngaphandle kwemthungo nemaphethini lacondzile ekusebenta kwelicembu lakho.
solutionEngineering.row2P1: Hlanganisa tinhlelo tesoftware letingafani tibe yi-ecosystem yedijithali lehlangene. Sikha ema-API e-REST kanye ne-GraphQL, baphatsi be-webhook, kanye nemigca yemilayeto yemabhizinisi kucinisekisa kuvumelanisa kwemininingwane ngesikhatsi sangempela kuwo onkhe emapulatifomu akho.
solutionEngineering.row2P2: Noma ngabe kuhlanganisa emathuluzi e-SaaS ebantfu besitsatfu noma kwelula emapulatifomu lakhona endzaweni, takhiwo tetfu tekuhlanganisa tibeka embili bucotfo bedatha, kusebenta, kanye nesikhatsi sekungasebenti.
solutionEngineering.row3P1: Phakamisa tindlela tekusebentisana telifa ngetipiliyoni temsebentisi tesimanje, letiphendvulako letentelwe kushesha nekucaca. Siphindze sinjiniyela ema-frontends ngemaphethini ekuklama labonakalako, kuhambisana nekufinyeleleka, kanye netimodeli tekusebentisana letilungisiwe.
solutionEngineering.row3P2: Ngekufanana, bonjiniyela betfu bekusebenta benta kahle imibuto ye-database, emasu ekugcina, kanye nebukhulu be-frontend bundle kute baletse tikhatsi tekuphendvula letisheshako kuwo onkhe emadivayisi.
solutionEngineering.pillarsSub: Tindlela tekwenta ngekwemvelo letisesigabeni sebhizinisi letakhiwe kute tilinganiselwe ngaphandle kwemthungo.
solutionEngineering.pillar1Desc: Logic yesicelo lelungiselelwe kanye nemishini yembuso letentekelako lelungiselelwe ngco eceleni kwemitsetfo yakho yekusebenta yangaphakathi.
solutionEngineering.pillar2Desc: Emabhuloho emininingwane laphephile, lacinisekisiwe lahlanganisa ema-backends laphetse, ema-ERP suites, emasango ekukhokha, kanye netinsizakalo temafu.
solutionEngineering.pillar3Desc: Kuguculwa kwekwakha lokujulile lokugucula isoftware yemabhizinisi ngaphandle kwekwephula tindlela tekutfutfukisa noma tivumelwano tekusekelwa kwebatsengisi.
solutionEngineering.pillar4Desc: Kuphrofayela kwemibuto lokunelulaka, kucedza kuvuza kwememori, kanye nekusabalalisa kwe-CDN lesemnceleni kwekulayisha emakhasi langaphansi kwesibili.
solutionEngineering.ctaTitle: Ukulungele kwenta Ipulatifomu Yakho Yebhizinisi Ibe Ngendlela Loyifunako?
solutionEngineering.ctaSub: Xhumana nebakhi betfu betisombululo kute baklame futsi basebentise emamojuli lakhetsiwe, kuhamba kwemisebenti, kanye nekuhlanganiswa lokuhambisana netidzingo tebhizinisi lakho.

digitalTransformation.description: Kuguculwa kwetintfo tesimanjemanje letiphelele tetinchubo temabhizinisi, takhiwo tebuchwepheshe, kanye netimodeli tekusebenta kute kuchutshwe kushesha kwenhlangano, kusebenta kahle, kanye nekukhula lokusimeme kwedijithali.
digitalTransformation.row1P1: Sibambisana nebaholi bemabhizinisi kute sichaze lisu ledijithali, emacala ebhizinisi, kanye nemabalave emigwaco ngetigaba ngekuwina lokusheshako kanye nekubulawa lokungenabungoti.
digitalTransformation.row1P2: Tinyatselo letibekwe embili, timodeli te-TCO, kanye nema-KPI kucinisekisa kutsi yonkhe imitamo yekwentiwa kwebuchwepheshe besimanje ubopha ngco imali lengenako, kusebenta kahle, kanye nemiphumela yekweneliseka kwemakhasimende.
digitalTransformation.row2Title: Yenta tintfo tesimanje Ngaphandle Kwekuphula Libhizinisi
digitalTransformation.row2P1: Phindza ubeke ema-monoliths kuma-microservices, ema-API, kanye nemaphethini emdzabu emafu ngekunciphisa sikhatsi sekungasebenti kanye nekucinisekiswa kwekubuyela emuva lokuzenzakalelayo.
digitalTransformation.row2P2: Senta tinhlelo tekusebenta, ema-database, kanye netinhlayiya tekuhlanganisa tibe tesimanjemanje ngesikhatsi sigcina kuhambisana kanye nekuma kwekuphepha.
digitalTransformation.row3P1: Yamukela i-AWS, i-Azure, ne-GCP, yakha emaphayiphi emininingwane yesimanje, futsi ufake ema-ejenti ekufundza ngemshini kute ashayele tincumo letitimele.
digitalTransformation.row3P2: Kusuka ekusakateni kwemcimbi ngesikhatsi sangempela kuya kumadeshibhodi lahlangene, kugucuka kuba yintfo lelinganisekako futsi lesimeme.
digitalTransformation.row4P1: Yakha kabusha luhambo lwemakhasimende kuyo yonkhe iwebhu lephendvulako, iOS, Android, kanye nema-portal ekutisebenta ngetindlela tekusebentisana letikhetsekile.
digitalTransformation.row4P2: Bunjiniyela bepulatifomu, i-telemetry, kanye netiluphu tekuphendvula letizenzakalelako kwenta kutsi kusungulwa kwedijithali kuchubeke.
digitalTransformation.pillarsSub: Ema-lever lagcile emphumeleni lacinisekisa buholi bedijithali lobusimeme.
digitalTransformation.pillar1Desc: Emapulani ekugucula ngetigaba ngekumodela emacala ebhizinisi, kubusa kwekwakha, kanye nekulandzelela bungoti lobubalulekile.
digitalTransformation.pillar2Desc: AWS/Azure/GCP tisekelo temafu lamanyenti, emaphayiphi latentekelako, kanye nekuniketa emandla ekuhlatiya idatha yemabhizinisi.
digitalTransformation.pillar3Desc: Kusebenta ngekuzenzakalela kwenchubo lehlakaniphile, ema-ejenti e-AI lacondzako, kanye ne-telemetry lebiketelako kute kwentiwe kahle kusebenta kwamalanga onkhe.
digitalTransformation.pillar4Desc: Ema-portal edijithali e-omnichannel lagucula kakhulu kanye netindlela tekusebentisana letikhetsekile letakhelwe kugcinwa kwemsebentisi lomkhulu.
digitalTransformation.ctaSub: Kusebentisana ne-Oklut Technologies kute kube nekuguculwa kwedijithali ngetigaba, lokungenabungoti lokuboshelwe emiphumeleni yelibhizinisi lelinganisekako.

endToEndSolutions.description: Luhlaka lwekuletsa loluhlelekile, loluphelele lolufaka ekhatsi tidzingo tebhizinisi, kwakhiwa kwekwakha, bunjiniyela, kuhlanganiswa, kucinisekisa lizinga, kusetjentiswa kwemafu, kanye nemisebenti lelawulwako.
endToEndSolutions.row1P1: Imihlangano yekusebenta ngekubambisana, kwenta emabalave esizinda sebhizinisi, kanye netincazelo tekwakhiwa kwemafu letentelwe kucedza bungoti ngaphambi kwekutsi kubhalwe umugca wekhodi.
endToEndSolutions.row1P2: Sichaza timodeli tedatha, tinhlaka tekuphepha, kanye netigaba tekukala letibeka imphumelelo yesikhatsi lesidze.
endToEndSolutions.row2P1: Ema-microservices lakhiwe ngemamojula, ema-API laphephile eluhlobo, kanye nema-frontends laphendvulako lahlanganiswe neyunithi letentekelako, kuhlanganiswa, kanye nekuskena kwekuphepha.
endToEndSolutions.row2P2: Emaphayiphi ekuhlanganisa lachubekako ngeTento te-GitHub, i-Terraform, kanye netindlela tekuphepha letizenzakalelayo.
endToEndSolutions.row3P1: Kuhlanganiswa kwemafu lamanyenti ku-AWS/Azure/GCP ngekubuyela emuva lokuzenzakalelayo, kusikwa kwesikhatsi sekungasebenti, kanye nekubukwa ngesikhatsi sangempela.
endToEndSolutions.row3P2: Siniketa kugcinwa lokusekelwe yi-SLA kanye nekugadza lokuchubekako kwe-telemetry kute kuguculwe umkhicito wakho ngaphandle kwemthungo.
endToEndSolutions.row4P1: Kulandzisa ngephuzu linye kulo lonkhe imfumba yakho yedijithali — sivinini sekugijima lesisobala, kusabelomali lesicagelako, kanye nekusungula lokuchubekako.
endToEndSolutions.row4P2: Kukhishwa kwetici njalo kanye nemijikeleto yesimanjemanje kugcina libhizinisi lakho lihamba embili emncintiswaneni.
endToEndSolutions.pillarsSub: Njalo sigaba unjiniyela nge rigor ibhizinisi.
endToEndSolutions.pillar1Desc: Kutfolakala kwesizinda, emabalave emigwaco yekwakha, kanye nekuhambisana kwalabatsintsekako kute kucedvwe bungoti bekubulawa.
endToEndSolutions.pillar2Desc: Ema-microservices lacinile lavela emafini, kuhlanganiswa kwe-API, kanye nekuhlolwa kwe-QA lokuchubekako.
endToEndSolutions.pillar3Desc: Kulandzela kuphepha kwe-Zero-trust, kukhishwa kwetitja, kanye nekusetjentiswa kwemafu lokuzenzakalelayo.
endToEndSolutions.pillar4Desc: 24/7 SLA kugadza, telemetry yetemphilo, kanye nebunjiniyela lobuchubekako bekutigucukela kwemvelo.
endToEndSolutions.ctaSub: Sinemjikeleto wemphilo lephelele yetebucwepheshe kute licembu lakho likhone kugcila emiphumeleni lebalulekile yebhizinisi.

migrationServices.description: Kufuduka lokuphephile, lokuhlelekile kwetinhlelo tekusebenta telifa, ema-database, kanye nesakhiwonchanti kuya ekwakhiweni kwemafu esimanje, lokuhambisana nekuchubeka nekwentiwa kwetintfo tesimanje kute kukhuliswe kushesha kanye nekusebenta kahle.
migrationServices.row1P1: Kufuduka kwemsebenti lokungenamthungo kuyo yonkhe i-AWS, i-Azure, ne-Google Cloud ngekutfolakala lokuzenzakalelayo, kuhlela emagagasi, kanye nekuphazamiseka kwebhizinisi lokute.
migrationServices.row1P2: Silinganisa kubamba kabusha, kuphindze sibeke kabusha, kanye nekuphindze sibeke kabusha kute sikhulise tindleko letiphelele tebunikati (TCO) kanye nekushesha.
migrationServices.row2P1: Kuphindzaphindza kwedathabheyisi letentekelako, kuhumusha kwe-schema, kanye nemaphayiphi e-ETL lakhicita kakhulu ngekucinisekisa bucotfo bedatha nga-100%.
migrationServices.row2P2: Kuprakthiza kwekunciphisa sikhatsi sekungasebenti kucinisekisa kuhambisana kwemininingwane lephelele kanye nekuchubeka kwebhizinisi.
migrationServices.row3P1: Kwenta ema-monoliths lasesigabeni sesimanjemanje abe ngemasevisi lamancane lalinganisekako lahlelwe nge-Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) ngemapulani e-IaC latentekelako.
migrationServices.row3P2: Kuphrofayela kwekusebenta ngemuva kwekufuduka kanye nekusebenta kahle kwetindleko kucinisekisa i-ROI lesheshako.
migrationServices.row4Title: Kuhlolwa Lokuzenzakalelako & Emanethi Ekuphepha Labuyiselwa Emuva
migrationServices.row4P1: Tincwadzi tekugijima letihlolwe emphini, ema-suite ekubuyela emuva latentekelako, kanye netindlela tekubuyela emuva letisheshako kute utfole kuthula kwengcondvo lokuphelele.
migrationServices.row4P2: I-telemetry yetemphilo ngemuva kwekufuduka kanye nekunakekelwa kakhulu 24/7 kucinisekisa kusimama kwekukhicita lokute sici.
migrationServices.pillar1Desc: I-Canary ikhipha kanye nekuvumelanisa kwekubhala kabili kwe-database kucinisekisa kufinyelela kwemsebentisi lokungaphazamiseki.
migrationServices.pillar2Desc: Kucatsanisa kwe-Checksum, kucwaningwa kwebucotfo be-schema, kanye nekubuyisana kwe-ETL lokuzenzakalelayo.
migrationServices.pillar3Desc: Imigomo lecinile yekululama ngesikhatsi setinhlekelele kanye nekuprakthiza kute kube nebungoti kuto tonkhe tigaba.
migrationServices.pillar4Desc: Kufaka ekhatsi emalungelo e-Cloud, tinchubomgomo tekulinganisa ngekuzenzakalela, kanye nemadeshibhodi ekulawula tindleko.
migrationServices.ctaSub: Kusebentisana ne-Oklut Technologies kute kwentiwe lifu lelihlelekile, lelite bungoti kanye nemininingwane yesimanje.

pilotPrototyping.description: Kutfutfukiswa ngekushesha kanye nekucinisekiswa kwetisombululo tebuchwepheshe kute kuhlolelwe kutsi tebuchwepheshe tingasebenta yini, linani lebhizinisi, tidzingo tekuhlanganiswa, kusebenta, kanye nekulinganisa ngaphambi kwekucala kusebenta ngalokugcwele.
pilotPrototyping.row1Title: Kusuka kuMcondvo kuya ekucinisekiseni kutsi kungenteka
pilotPrototyping.row1P1: Kugucula umcondvo ube sisombululo sesikali sebhizinisi kudzinga kucinisekiswa lokucinile kwangaphambilini. Insizakalo yetfu ye-PoC & Pilot ihlola kusebenta kwetebucwepheshe, kucindzeteleka-kuhlola tikhonkwane tekuhlanganisa letibucayi, futsi kucinisekisa i-ROI yebhizinisi ngaphambi kwekutibophelela lokukhulu kwemali lenkhulu.
pilotPrototyping.row1P2: Sakha ema-MVP lasetulu ekwetsembeka kanye nebashayeli be-sandbox labagcile labafakazela kukhonakala kwetebucwepheshe, balinganise kuphuta kweluhlelo, futsi sibutsele ndzawonye kucinisekiswa kwebantfu labatsintsekako ngalokucondzile kusenesikhatsi.
pilotPrototyping.row1Cap: Kukhicita Sibonelo Se-MVP Lesheshako & Tilinganiso Tebuchwepheshe

aiRobotics.intro: I-Artificial Intelligence (i-AI) kanye ne-Robotics kugucula indlela emabhizinisi lasebenta ngayo ngekuhlanganisa kwenta tincumo letihlakaniphile kanye nekusebenta ngekuzenzakalela lokusezingeni lelisetulu. I-AI yenta kutsi imishini ihlatiye idatha, ifundze emaphethini, futsi yente tincumo letihlakaniphile, kantsi emarobhothi aletsa lamakhono emhlabeni lobonakalako kute ente imisebenti ngekushesha, ngekuciniseka, nangekungagucugucuki.
aiRobotics.section1Heading: Yakhiwe kwenta yonkhe imisebenti ibe lula
aiRobotics.section1Text: Tisombululo tetfu te-AI ne-Robotics tisita tinhlangano kutsi tilungise imisebenti, tinciphise umtamo wesandla, futsi titfutfukise umkhicito etimbonini letehlukahlukene. Kusuka ekusebentiseni inchubo ngekutentela kanye nekuhlatiya lokubiketelako kuya kumarobhothi lahlakaniphile kanye netinhlelo letihlakaniphile, siletsa tebuchwepheshe lobusha lobutfutfukisa kusebenta kahle, bukhutsata kukhula, futsi busekela tingucuko tedijithali.
aiRobotics.section2Text: Njalo kusebentisana, sincumo, kanye nekuhamba kuniketwa emandla luhlelo lunye loluxhunyiwe — kugucula idatha ibe yimiphumela ngesikhatsi sangempela.

informationReporting.heroSubtitle: Umtfombo munye weliciniso kuwo onkhe ematiko — lakhiwe kugucula idatha yekusebenta leluhlata ibe tincumo ibhizinisi lakho lingasebenta ngato lamuhla.
informationReporting.section1Heading: Luhlelo lunye lolusemkhatsini lwawo onkhe emamethrikhi labalulekile
informationReporting.section1P1: Tinhlelo Telwatiso Nekubika tisombululo letibalulekile tebhizinisi letivumela tinhlangano kutsi tibutsele ndzawonye, tilawule, futsi tiguculele idatha ibe yimibono lenenshokutsi. Letinhlelo tihlanganisa lwati loluvela ematiko lamanyenti, kucinisekisa kufinyelela lokunembile, lokungagucuki, kanye nesikhatsi lesifanele kudatha lebalulekile yebhizinisi. Ngekuniketa inkhundla lehlanganisiwe yekulawula lwati, tinhlangano tingakhona kwenta ncono kubonakala kwekusebenta, kwenta umsebenti uhambe kahle, futsi tisekele kwenta tincumo temasu kuwo onkhe emazinga ebhizinisi.
informationReporting.section1P2: Letinhlelo tisebentisa kubika lokutentakalelako, kuhlatiya, kanye nemadeshibhodi kulandzelela kusebenta, kugadza emamethrikhi labalulekile, kanye nekukhicita imibiko yesikhatsi sangempela. Ngekunciphisa umsebenti wesandla kanye nekutfutfukisa kuciniseka kwemininingwane, emabhizinisi angenta tincumo letisheshako naletiphumelelako.
informationReporting.section2Text: Ngekubonakala lokutfutfukisiwe, kuhambisana, kanye nekubambisana, Tinhlelo Telwatiso Nekubika tisita tinhlangano kutsi tikhone kusebentisa kahle tinchubo, kwenta ncono umkhicito, kanye nekuchuba kukhula kwebhizinisi lokusimeme esimeni sekuncintisana.
informationReporting.ctaHeading: Niketa wonkhe licembu sitfombe lesifanako sesikhatsi sangempela sebhizinisi.
informationReporting.ctaText: Bona kutsi i-Nexus Data Systems ingahlanganisa njani kubika kwakho kube yipulatifomu yinye lehlakaniphile.

artificialIntelligence.ctaDescription: Tfola kutsi kusebenta ngekutentela lokuhlakaniphile, ema-copilots emabhizinisi kanye nemamodeli labiketelako angavula njani kusebenta kahle kuto tonkhe tinhlelo takho letiyinhloko.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P1: Kwaphela iminyaka, buhlakani bekufakelwa bemabhizinisi bebutsatfwa njengelikhono langaphandle: imodeli lececeshwe ngekwehlukana, umbukiso webhokisi lesihlabathi, noma i-chatbot leyehlukile lefinyeleleka nge-portal lehlukile. I-AI yemabhizinisi lenemtselela lomkhulu ifakwe ngco ngekhatsi kwetinhlelo tekurekhoda-ema-ERP, ema-CRM, emapulatifomu ebantfu, kanye netinjini tekuphakela lapho kwenteka khona ibhizinisi mbamba.

artificialIntelligence.sec2P1: Kusebentisa Inchubo Yemarobhothi Yendzabuko (RPA) kwenta kahle kakhulu ekukhuhleni kwesikrini lokucinile, lokuphindzaphindziwe. modernErp.ctaHeading: Yenta Imisebenti Yelibhizinisi Lakho Ibe Yesimanje
modernErp.ctaDescription: Hlola kutsi emapulatifomu e-ERP esimanjemanje ahlanganisa njani timali, kutsenga, umjikeleto wekuniketa kanye nemisebenti yemabhizinisi ngesisekelo se-digital lesihlangene.
modernErp.sec1P1: Etindzaweni temabhizinisi letihamba ngekushesha, tinhlelo tekuHlela Tinsita Temabhizinisi tendzabuko tivame kulwa. Yakhiwe ngesikhatsi sekucubungula ngemaqoqo kanye nemaseva endzawo lahlukanisiwe, ema-ERP elifa abekwentiwe ngekwemvelo kakhulu, kumatima kuwatfutfukisa, futsi abengabonakali ngendlela lebuhlungu. Imisebenti lebalulekile yemabhizinisi beyisebenta ngetindlela letifanako, yetsembele ekutfumeleni emave labutsakatsaka ebusuku kute kuvumelaniswe ema-ledger nema-warehouse.
modernErp.sec1P2: I-ERP yesimanje, yemafu-yemdzabu ichaza kabusha ngalokuyinhloko loku lokugucugucukako. Isebenta njengemgogodla lohlangene wedijithali welibhizinisi-sisekelo lesiphilako lapho khona timali, kutsenga, umjikeleto wekuniketa, inventory, kanye nemitfombolusito yebantfu kusebentisana ngemodeli yedatha leyabelwana ngayo.
modernErp.sec1P3: Ngekuletsa imisebenti lebalulekile endzaweni yinye levumelanako, i-ERP yesimanje isusa tindzawo letingaboni kahle tekusebenta letinciphisa kukhula, kwenta baholi kutsi bacondzise libhizinisi basebentisa timphawu tesikhatsi sangempela kunetifingqo temlandvo letindzala.
modernErp.sec3P1: Ema-silo lasebentako akuvamile kutsi abe tinkinga tebantfu; tinkinga tekwakha. Lapho inkonzo yemakhasimende, kutsenga, kanye nemacembu e-warehouse asebenta eticelweni letingakahlanganiswa, konkhe kuniketa kudzinga ema-imeyili labhalwe ngesandla, emaspredishithi, kanye nekushaya lucingo. Emaphutsa ayandza, ema-inivoyisi ayabanjwa, futsi kutibophelela kwemakhasimende kuyashibilika.
modernErp.sec3P2: I-ERP yesimanje ibhekana naloku ngekusebentisa luhlu lwemininingwane loluhlangene kanye nekuhlanganiswa kwenchubo lecondziswa ngumcimbi:

sec3List.text: Uma kufakwa i-oda lekhasimende, inventory iyagcinwa ngekuzenzakalela, emalebuli ekutfumela ayakhicita, futsi ema-ledger ekukhokha ayavuselelwa ngaso leso sikhatsi.
Ema-oda ekutsenga, emarisidi emphahla, kanye nema-inivoyisi ebatsengisi ahambisana ngekutentakalela nekubuyisana kwetindlela letingu-3, kukhombisa kuphela lokuhlukile kwekubuyeketwa kwebantfu.
Emaphepha esikhatsi ephrojekthi, kwabiwa kwemiholo, kanye netindleko tekusebenta leticondzile kumephu ngco etikhungweni tetindleko ngesikhatsi lesifanele.

modernErp.sec4P1: Kusebenta libhizinisi ngaphandle kwekubonakala lokuhlangene kufana nekundiza enkungwini leminyene ngetintfo tekusebenta letibambelele. I-ERP yesimanje iniketa i-telemetry yesikhatsi sangempela kuyo yonkhe imikhakha yebhizinisi:

sec4List.text: Imibono lesheshako yemamargin laphelele, kuhamba kwemali lesebentako, tikweleti letivulekile, kanye nekusalela emuva kwema-oda ngaphandle kwekulindza kuvalwa kwekuphela kwesikhatsi.
Tinhloko tematiko tingakha imibuto yesiko futsi tibhobote phansi kusuka etifinyetweni letisezingeni lemabhizinisi kuya etintfweni temugca wekutsengiselana ngamunye.
Kucedza tinombolo letiphikisanako ngekusungula idatha lenkhulu lebuswa yinye yemakhasimende, batsengisi, kanye nemakhathalogu emikhicito.
Tecwayiso letizenzakalelayo tatisa baphatsi ngekushesha nangabe emamargin ehla ngaphansi kwemkhawulo, inventory iphelile, noma kuhanjiswa kwemphakeli kushibilika.

Kubusa umtsengisi kanye nebungoti bebantfu besitsatfu ngendlela lelula ngekulawula kufinyelela lokuhlangene
Kwetsemba emaklayenti nebatjalimali lokutfutfukisiwe lokusekelwe ngetindlela tekuphepha leticinisekisiwe te-zero-trust
zeroTrustPrinciples: Ungalokotsi Wetsembe, Cinisekisa Ngaso Sonkhe Sikhatsi: Kucinisekisa lokucacile kuyadzingeka kuyo yonkhe imisebenti
Kufinyelela Lokuncane-Emalungelo: Imingcele yendzima ye-Granular lenciphisa kuhamba kwekusongela lokuseceleni
Cabanga Kwephulwa: Kugadza lokuchubekako kwekusongela, kubhala ngesikhatsi sekuhamba nasekuphumuleni
Kuhlukaniswa lokuncane: Tindvonga temlilo tenethiwekhi letihlukanisa imithwalo yemsebenti weluhlelo ngalunye
I-Telemetry Lechubekako: Kuhlatiya kutiphatsa lokuzenzakalelayo lokukhombisa ticelo teseshini letingakavami
cybersecurity.sec1Subtext: Njengobe tinhlangano tesimanje tihlanganisa tinhlelo tekusebenta letinyenti, tindzawo temafu, tisebenti letikhashane, emadivayisi eselula, kanye nebalingani bebantfu besitsatfu, umkhawulo wekuphepha wesintfu uyayekela kuba khona.
cybersecurity.sec2Subtext: Tindlela tekutivikela letivikela sakhiwonchanti lesibucayi, idatha yetinkampani lebucayi, kanye netinhlelo tekusebenta.
cybersecurity.sec3Subtext: Bunikati yindiza yekulawula lesisekelo yekuphepha kwesimanje. Cishe konkhe kwephulwa kwekuphepha lokubi kakhulu kucala ngekutsi kusetjentiswe ticu kunekutsi kusetjentiswe kabi isoftware.
cybersecurity.sec4Subtext: I-Zero Trust akusiwo umkhicito nobe lithulusi linye. Kulisu lekwakha lelisekelwe esimisweni lesicondzile: ungatsembi lutfo ngekhatsi noma ngaphandle kwenethiwekhi ngekuzenzakalela.
cybersecurity.sec5Subtext: Kuvikela imithwalo yemsebenti kulo lonkhe lifu lemmango, takhiwo letihlangene, kanye netindzawo tetitja letisakatiwe.
cybersecurity.sec6Subtext: Kucinisela kweliciniso kwe-inthanethi kwemukela kutsi tigameko tingavela. Kulungela kugcila ekuvimbeleni ngekushesha, kuphazamiseka lokuncane kwebhizinisi, kanye nekululama lokucinisekisiwe.
cybersecurity.sec7Subtext: Kwakha libhizinisi lelimelana ne-inthanethi kuvikela linani lenhlangano, kuma kwekulawula, kanye nelidvumela lemakethe.
cybersecurity.ctaDescription: Hlola kutsi tinhlangano tingacinisa njani kuphepha, tivikele tinhlelo letibucayi futsi tilungiselele tinsongo kuto tonkhe tindzawo letihlangene kakhulu.
cybersecurity.sec1P1: Ngesikhatsi selifa le-IT yemabhizinisi, kuphepha bekusebenta ngemfundziso ye-castle-and-moat: konkhe lokungekhatsi kwenethiwekhi yemahhovisi enkampani bekucatjangwa kutsi kuyatsembeka, kantsi konkhe lokungaphandle bekutsatfwa njengalokungatsembeki. I-firewall yinye yenkampani beyivikela emaseva langekhatsi, ema-database, kanye nemakhompyutha lasetafuleni.
cybersecurity.sec1P2: Libhizinisi lamuhla selikhule kakhulu kunetindvonga letibonakalako. Imithwalo yemsebenti ihlala etindzaweni letinemafu lamanyenti (AWS, Azure, GCP), tisebenti tifinyelela tinhlelo tebhizinisi letivela etindzaweni letehlukahlukene, futsi ema-API achubeka ashintjana ngemininingwane lebucayi yekusebenta nebahlinzeki bekuhambisa bangaphandle, tikhungo tetimali, kanye nebatsengisi be-SaaS.
cybersecurity.sec1P3:
Ngesikhatsi loku kuxhumana lokukhulu kushayela kushesha lokukhulu kwebhizinisi, kwandisa kakhulu indzawo yekuhlaselwa kwebhizinisi. Njalo i-API endpoint, ithokheni yebunikati, idivayisi yeselula lexhunyiwe, kanye nekuhlanganiswa kwe-SaaS kumele i-vector lengaba khona yekuchayeka. Kuvikelwa kwemabhizinisi kweliciniso kudzinga kushintja kusuka ekuvikeleni lokusekelwe ku-perimeter kuya ekuciniseni lokusebentako, lokuphelele ekugcineni kuya ekugcineni kwe-inthanethi.
🛡

sec2Cards.title: Kutfola Tinsongo
sec2Cards.desc: Buhlakani bekusongela lobusitwa kufundza ngemshini lobugadza emaphethini enethiwekhi langakavami, kuhlukunyetwa kweticu, kanye nekuba sengotini kwelilanga le-zero ngesikhatsi lesifanele.

sec2Cards.title: Kugadza Tekuphepha
sec2Cards.desc:
Sikhungo Semisebenti Yekuphepha Lesemkhatsini (i-SOC) telemetry lehambisana netehlakalo kuwo onkhe emaseva, emacembu etitja, bahlinzeki bebunikati, kanye netindzawo tekugcina.
🔍

sec2Cards.title: Kulawula Bungotini
sec2Cards.desc: Kuhlolwa kwebutsakatsaka lokuchubekako lokutentakalelako kuyo yonkhe indzawo yesakhiwonchanti, emarekhodi emtfombo, kanye nemarejista etitja kute kulungiswe butsakatsaka ngekushesha.

sec2Cards.title: Kuvikelwa kwemininingwane
sec2Cards.desc: Kubhala lokucinile ngesikhatsi sekuhamba (TLS 1.3) nasekuphumuleni (AES-256), eceleni kwekubusa kwekuvikela kulahleka kwemininingwane ye-granular (DLP) kuvikela kuvuza kwemphahla yebuhlakani.

cybersecurity.sec3P1: Kuvikela timphahla temabhizinisi kudzinga kucinisekisa kutsi wonkhe umuntfu—kungaba ngumphatsi webantfu, inkontileka yangaphandle, noma i-akhawunti yensizakalo yesoftware letimele—inekugunyatwa lokucinisekisiwe kwetinsita leticondzile letifinyelela kuto.

sec3List.text: Kungena Ngemvume Munye (SSO) kanye nemazinga ebunikati lahlanganisiwe lacedza titolo temaphasiwedi letihlukene kuto tonkhe tinhlelo tekusebenta.
Tikhiye te-FIDO2 te-hardware letimelana ne-phishing kanye netinsayeya tesimo letisekelwe ebungotini temisebenti yekuphatsa lebucayi.
Kulawula kufinyelela lokusekelwe eNdzimeni (RBAC) kanye nalokusekelwe etimfanelo (ABAC) lokunetinhlavu letincane lokuphocelelwa emazingeni e-API kanye ne-database.
Kuniketa kufinyelela kwesikhashana, ngesikhatsi lesifanele (JIT) lokuphelelwa sikhatsi ngekuzenzakalela uma imisebenti yekuphatsa iphetsa.

cybersecurity.keyPerspectiveLead: Kusakhiwo se-Zero Trust, kwetsemba lokungakacaci lokusekelwe endzaweni yenethiwekhi kuyabhidlitwa ngalokuphelele. Njalo kuthengiselana, umbuto we-database, kanye nekungena ngemvume kwemsebentisi kumele kuchubeke kufakazele kuba semtsetfweni kwako:

cloudSecurityCards.title: Umsebenti Lohlanganyelwe
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Kubusa lokucacile lokwehlukanisa kuphepha kwesakhiwonchanti lesibonakalako semhlinzeki welifu kusuka emsebentini welibhizinisi wekubhala idatha, tinchubomgomo te-IAM, kanye nekhodi yesicelo.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Sakhiwonchanti njengeKhodi (IaC)
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Kucushwa kwemafu lokungagucuki, lokuhlolwako lokulawulwa ngekhodi. Tiskena letizenzakalelako tenchubomgomo-njengekhodi tivimba kulungiswa kabi kanye nemabhakede lavulekile ngaphambi kwekutsi kusetjentiswe.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Sitja Nekuphepha Kwe-Kubernetes
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Tikhatsi tekusebenta tesitja leticinile, emarejista etitfombe lasayiniwe, kuhlukaniswa kancane kwenethiwekhi, kanye nekulawula imfihlo lokuzenzakalelayo lokugcina ticinisekiso tingafiki etindzaweni tekugcina umtfombo.

cloudModernization.sec1Subtext: Ema-monoliths lagugile avimbela sivinini sekusungulwa, akhulise butsakatsaka bekusebenta, futsi akhulise tindleko tekunakekelwa kwesakhiwonchanti.
cloudModernization.sec2Subtext: Kuphumelelisa kwenta emafu esimanjemanje kucala ngekuhlola lokucinile. Kugcuma ngco ekufudukeni ngaphandle kwekuhlola kuncika kwesicelo kuyimbangela leyinhloko yekubambelela kwekusika.
cloudModernization.sec3Subtext: Kute lisu lekufuduka lelifanako. Emabhizinisi laholako ahambisana nephethini lefanele yesimanjemanje kumsebenti ngamunye lotsite ngekuya ngenani lebhizinisi, kuphutfuma, kanye nesikweleti sebuchwepheshe.
cloudModernization.sec4Subtext: Indlela lehlelekile legucula ema-monoliths elifa abe tinsita temafu leticinile, letiphephile, naletigcinwako.
cloudModernization.sec5Subtext: Kuhambisa tinhlelo telifa kuya ekwakhiweni kwemafu esimanje kuletsa kushesha lokubonakalako kwekusebenta kanye nekubiketela tindleko.
cloudModernization.ctaHeading: Yenta Ticelo Takho Telifa Tibe Tesimanje
cloudModernization.ctaDescription: Hlola indlela lesebentako yekuhlola, kwenta tintfo tesimanje kanye nekuhambisa tinhlelo telifa letibhekiswe ekwakhiweni kwemafu lokulinganisekako, lokuphephile.
cloudModernization.sec1P1: Ticelo letibalulekile temsebenti letakhiwe eminyakeni lelishumi leyengcile tisachuba tigidzigidzi temali lengenako yemabhizinisi, noma kunjalo kucina kwato kwekwakha kudala ingoti lekhulako yekusebenta.
cloudModernization.sec1P2: Wonkhe emabhizinisi abhekene nekungevani emkhatsini wekusimama kanye nekwentiwa kwetintfo tesimanje. Tinhlelo temafa takhiwe kute tikhone kuhlala sikhatsi lesidze, futsi setisebente ngekwetsembeka iminyaka leminyenti. Kepha, njengoba tidzingo tebhizinisi tisheshisa, letakhiwo letigugile tihlangabetana nemikhawulo yesakhiwo:

sec1List.text: Emakhodibase e-Monolithic lakhiwe ngetinhlaka letilahliwe letinemadamu emathalenta lanciphako lakhonakalako ekugcinwa.
Tincenye letihlanganiswe kahle lapho kushintja sici sinye kubeka engotini kwephula emamojuli ekusebenta langahlobene.
Imikhawulo yekukala lemile ledzinga kutsenga ihardware lebitako yemphahla yekuphatsa kukhula kwetimoto ngesikhatsi lesitsite.
Kungakhoni kusebentisana kahle netinhlelo tekusebenta tesimanje temaselula, ema-portal emakhasimende, noma ema-API ebalingani ngaphandle kwemibhalo ye-batch lebutsakatsaka.
Imijikeleto yekuphila kwegumbi leseva lebonakalako, butsakatsaka besipele, kanye netindleko tekusebenta temandla/ekupholisa letisetulu.

cloudModernization.sec2P1: Luhambo lwesimanjemanje lolusebentako lucala ngekusungula kucaca lokuphelele kulo lonkhe lifa lelikhona:

sec2List.text: Kufaka phansi yonkhe imisebenti lesebentako, emamojula lakhetsiwe, imibhalo yangemuva, kanye nemaphakheji ebantfu besitsatfu lanemlandvo.

Kubeka emabalave ekuhlanganiswa kwesikhatsi sekugijima lesiyinkimbinkimbi, emathebula e-database lahlanganyelwe, lucingo lweluhlelo lwemafayela lolucondzile, kanye netinkontileka tetinsita tangephandle.
Kuhlola takhiwo tedatha, tidzingo tebucotfo bekutsengiselana, i-cadence yekusekela, kanye nemitsetfo yekutimela yekulawula.
Kucwaninga i-CPU, imemori, kusetjentiswa kwesitoreji, kanye nekusebenta kwenethiwekhi kuya etincazelweni telifu letihlosiwe letinesayizi lefanele.
Kuhlukanisa tinhlelo tekusebenta ngetigaba kute kwakhiwe emagagasi ekufuduka laphephile, lahamba ngetigaba ngetinchubo leticacile tekubuyela emuva.

cloudModernization.cloudArchitectureTitle: Kugeleta Kwesimanjemanje Kwemafu Kusuka Ekupheleni Kuya Ekugcineni
cloudModernization.sec4P1: Isakhiwo sendzawo yekuya khona sihlukanisa tinhlelo tekusebenta letiyinhloko tibe ngema-modular, tinsita letifakwe etitjeni letibanjwe kumapulatifomu emafu lacinile (njenge-Kubernetes noma tikhatsi tekusebenta letilawulwako letite iseva).
cloudModernization.sec4P2: Ngekusungula emaphayiphi e-CI/CD latentekelako, ema-cutover latentekelako laluhlata sasibhakabhaka, kanye nesakhiwonchanti njengekhodi, kusetjentiswa kugucula kusuka emicimbini yemphelasontfo ledzabula luvalo kube yimikhuba yemalanga onkhe lengenamthungo.
cloudModernization.sec4P3: I-Elastic compute iyakhuphuka ngekuzenzakalela ngesikhatsi sekukhula kwekufuna bese iyancipha ngesikhatsi sekuphumula, kucedza tindleko tetinsita letingasebenti ngesikhatsi kucinisekiswa tikhatsi tekuphendvula letingaphansi kwesibili kubasebentisi bemhlaba wonkhe.
cloudModernization.keyPerspectiveLead: Lokuhlangenwe nako kukhombisa kutsi emaphrojekthi esimanjemanje ayaphumelela uma asekelwe ekulungiseleleni lokuphelele, kulandzelana kwemagagasi lacacile, kanye nekuhlolwa kwetintfo leticinile:
